body:
Automated bridge job `RQ-REBASE-PHANTOM-4261` (pool: codex-personal), single commit on base `e14dc0535`.

**Tests:** no test command

**Tier-1 (CODEOWNERS) paths, async post-merge review:** .github/CODEOWNERS src/core/daemon/loop.ts test/fixtures/authority/tier1-closure.json

<details><summary>Agent notes</summary>

# RQ-REBASE-PHANTOM-4261

## Result

Prepared the existing PR's changes locally on current master; all changes remain
uncommitted and unstaged. The remote PR has not been updated or enqueued.
The task's final RULES explicitly prohibit commits, pushes and publication;
this takes precedence over the earlier request to update and enqueue the PR.
Additionally, `gh` cannot read its configuration in this execution environment.
No new PR, branch deletion, tag, release, live installation or security pin change.

## Exact source

- Existing PR: https://github.com/ashlrai/phantom/pull/4261 (open).
- Existing fork/head: `masonwyatt23/phantom`, `codex-bridge/RQ-HEAVYGATEN9CQ8`.
- Existing head SHA: `a23caeb726b504c3c5f731c205be12f2ac8d5996`.
- Initial default branch/base: `master`, `e14dc05359895de0bad9bff3cf8c285c4545d635`.
- Refreshed base: `master`, `d0bd3da2940d2e8c0d727054d673f8d060d6bfee`.
  A final GitHub read found master advanced by six files. Refreshed the local
  job branch with `git switch -C codex-bridge/RQ-REBASE-PHANTOM-4261 d0bd3da2940d2e8c0d727054d673f8d060d6bfee`,
  retaining all uncommitted changes. No new commit was created. The new base
  supplies its own reviewed closure snapshot update; this job did not edit it.
- GitHub reports the original PR is not mergeable. Original CI run
  `42589353630` and its required Merge Gate succeeded; these are historical
  results for the original head, not validation of this uncommitted tree.

## Changes

Replayed the original PR with `git diff <head>^ <head> -- | git apply --3way`.
Resolved the README append conflict by keeping every current-master section and
the PR's CPU-budget section. Preserved the shared heavy-command semaphore,
dispatcher CPU sampling, automatic helper entry and original regression tests.
Updated the two newer verify-changed cache/dedupe fixtures to copy the new
helper module and Python wrapper, preserving their existing assertions.
The first local gate also exposed pre-existing CODEOWNERS drift: the existing
`doctor-merge-path-cli`, `merge-path-readonly` and `merge-path` tests lacked
their generated entries. A read-only comparison proved that the candidate and
unchanged-master Tier-1 test classifications are identical. Regenerated only
CODEOWNERS, adding those three existing ownership entries. No new Tier-1 roots;
the authority closure snapshot is unchanged relative to the refreshed base.
The refreshed base also shipped `test/custody-wrap-receipt.test.ts` without
its generated ownership entry; included that fourth CODEOWNERS line.
That newly shipped custody test also failed its real marker assertion because
its broad execFileSync mock returned the Phantom path when resolving `touch`.
Limited the mock to Phantom discovery and delegated other calls to the real
implementation. All existing assertions remain; all eight cases now pass.
Ran `git restore --staged -- .` to leave the complete patch unstaged.

## Verification

All test commands use `env HOME="$(mktemp -d)"` for an isolated temporary home.

Final successful checks:

- `python3 -m unittest discover -s contrib/mac/tests -p test_fleet_heavy.py -v`:
  6 passed, 0 failed.
- `node --test scripts/verify-changed-slots.test.mjs`: 8 passed, 0 failed.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s contrib/mac/tests -p test_dispatchd.py`:
  all 79 passed, 0 failed.
- Affected backend suites: 83 passed, 0 failed (11 modules), using this exact
  command after the isolated dependency repair:

```sh
env HOME="$(mktemp -d)" npm run test:ci -- test/typecheck-fast-script.test.ts test/typecheck-fast-parse-args.test.ts test/typecheck-fast-projects.test.ts test/verify-changed-script.test.ts test/verify-changed-tsgo.test.ts test/verify-changed-tsc-cache.test.ts test/verify-changed-dedupe.test.ts test/verify-changed-eslint-preflight.test.ts test/verify-changed-realio-scope.test.ts test/verify-changed-registry-check.test.ts test/m372.test-ci-watchdog.test.ts
```

- `node scripts/verify-changed.mjs`: final run passed authority drift (10 tests),
  changed-file ESLint, backend native typecheck, real-I/O scope and console I/O
  checks. The first failed run was repeated only after dependency repair and
  the CODEOWNERS correction. Existing unregistered real-I/O tests are warnings
  in this changed-file gate; no changed test has an omission.
- `npm run typecheck`: final run passed both backend and web native compilers.
- `npm run test:ci -- test/custody-wrap-receipt.test.ts`: final 8 passed,
  0 failed on the refreshed base after the scoped mock repair (initially
  7 passed / 1 failed; the failure is corrected).
- `npm run check:docs`: passed, 0 documentation errors.
- `git diff --check`: passed. No unresolved conflict markers.

Final distinct regression total: **194 passed, 0 remaining test failures**
(6 semaphore + 8 slot + 83 helper + 79 dispatcher + 10 authority + 8 custody).
The one CODEOWNERS generation check is separate from that total. Repeated
authority/typecheck runs are not double-counted. The final changed-file gate
was rerun after both the refreshed-base ownership entry and custody mock fix.

Full lint is **not green**. `npm run lint:realio-lane` exits 1 for 17 existing,
unchanged test files missing from REAL_IO_TEST_FILES. The final full
`npm run lint` ESLint phase stayed silent for over ten minutes; terminated only
this job's ESLint process with SIGTERM (exit 143) after the independent full
guard had already established an aggregate lint failure. Changed-file ESLint
passed. The 17 unrelated omissions remain; no guard or assertion was weakened.

Environment/setup:

- `node --version`: v22.22.3.
- `npm install -g @ashlr/phantom`: failed EPERM in the global package directory;
  existing `phm --version` is 3.30.24.
- `phm docs --agent --json`, `phm help`, `phm mcp list --json`: completed.
- `phm mcp doctor --json`: health results include unavailable/time-out servers;
  no companion tools were called. `toolsUsed: []`.
- `phm wire status --json`: clients not wired / configuration access denied.
- `phm authority status --json`: authority dormant because build code changed.
- `phm authority setup --dry-run --json`: incomplete dry-run plan only.
  No setup, wiring, grants or authentication changes were applied.
- `gh pr view 4261 -R ashlrai/phantom --json number,url,title,state,mergedAt,closedAt,headRefName,headRefOid,baseRefName`:
  failed before authentication: config.yml access denied. Read-only GitHub
  connector calls supplied PR metadata, patch, master and workflow/job evidence.
- Initial `npm run typecheck`: blocked, `tsgo` missing (exit 127).
- A typecheck overlapping the subsequent dependency replacement also lost
  the web `tsgo` executable; the final two-project typecheck completed afterward.
- Initial `npm run lint`: blocked, ESLint `../lib/cli` missing (exit 2).
- `npm run install:worktree`: passed, including wt-deps and tsc-warm healing,
  but subsequent checks still found missing files in its shared store.
- Second `npm run lint`: blocked, missing TypeScript ESLint rule module.
- The first affected-test run reported 13 watchdog failures and then hit a
  missing `@vitest/utils/dist/helpers.js`; terminated that run (exit 143)
  and its in-flight verify-changed authority runner before repairing dependencies.
- The interrupted `node scripts/verify-changed.mjs` failed authority drift;
  CODEOWNERS had two failures before interruption. The read-only classification
  comparison above confirmed drift already existed on unchanged master.
- `npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --cache <temporary-directory>`:
  passed, installed 403 packages locally without changing manifests/lockfiles.
- `ASHLR_UPDATE_CODEOWNERS=1 npm run test:ci -- test/authority-codeowners-310b.test.ts`:
  regeneration passed (1 generation check); closure snapshot not regenerated.
- The first refreshed-base gate loaded CODEOWNERS before its newly required
  custody entry was added (8 passed / 2 failed); final gate passes all 10.

## Size and remaining work

Source/docs/test diff: **+310 / -4, net +306 lines**, including the original
PR's 291 lines, six fixture-copy lines, four CODEOWNERS entries and the custody
mock correction; 13 files, plus this required report (14 total).
Any later publication must update the existing fork branch and PR #4261 only,
through the sanctioned publisher; do not create a replacement PR. Fresh hosted
Merge Gate evidence and enqueueing remain outstanding. Dispatcher adoption
continues to require the existing Security review/re-pin process.
</details>
